name: Ninja Shinobi Illusionist
body:
A shinobi illusionist is the shadow and the night; she studies the arcane arts more intensely than her colleagues, hiding behind a mantle of spells and lies to bring confusion to her foes and accomplish her secret missions safely.

Weapon and Armor Proficiencies

A shinobi illusionist is not proficient with any armor or shields. Armor sometimes interferes with a shinobi illusionist’s gestures, which can cause her spells with somatic components to fail.

This alters the ninja’s armor proficiencies.

Class Skills: A shinobi illusionist gains Knowledge (arcana) and Spellcraft as class skills, but not Intimidate and Knowledge (local).

This alters the ninja’s skills.

Spellcasting

A shinobi illusionist casts arcane spells from the shinobi illusionist’s spell list, using the magus’ class spells per day table. The shinobi illusionist’s spell list includes all spells from the illusion school and all spells with the shadow descriptor from every class’ spell list. A shinobi illusionist must choose and prepare her spells ahead of time. She learns, prepares, and casts spells exactly as a wizard does, including adding new spells to her spellbook and gaining two additional spells known (of any level she can cast) each time she gains a ninja level with this archetype.

Magic Ki Pool (Su)

A shinobi illusionist cannot spend ki points to perform additional attacks or to increase her speed. Instead, a shinobi illusionist can spend 1 point of ki to add +1 to the DC of the next spell she casts on her turn.

In addition, she can spend 1 point of ki to gain a +4 insight bonus on Spellcraft checks for 1 round.

This modifies ki pool.

Poison Training

A shinobi illusionist doesn’t gain poison use at 1st level. She can take poison use instead of a ninja trick.

Illusion Master (Su)

At 3rd level, the DC to track a shinobi illusionist using the Survival skill increases by +1. In addition, a shinobi illusionist gains a +1 bonus on all saving throws against illusion and shadow spells and effects. Every three levels thereafter, these bonuses increase by 1.

This replaces no trace.

Ninja Tricks

At 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, the shinobi illusionist gains a ninja trick.

This modifies the normal ninja trick progression.

Spell Recall (Su)

At 4th level, with a swift action the shinobi illusionist can recall any single shinobi illusionist spell that he has already prepared and cast that day by expending a number of points from her ki pool equal to the spell’s level (minimum 1). The spell is prepared again, just as if it had not been cast. This replaces uncanny dodge. A 4th-level shinobi illusionist can select uncanny dodge as a ninja trick.

Improved Spell Recall (Su)

At 11th level, whenever the shinobi illusionist recalls a spell with spell recall, she expends a number of points from her ki pool equal to 1/2 the spell’s level (minimum 1). Furthermore, instead of recalling a used spell, as a swift action the shinobi illusionist can prepare a spell of the same level that she has in her spellbook. She does so by expending a number of points from her arcane pool equal to the spell’s level (minimum 1).

The shinobi illusionist cannot apply metamagic feats to a spell prepared in this way. The shinobi illusionist does not need to reference her spellbook to prepare a spell in this way. This replaces improved uncanny dodge. A 12th-level shinobi illusionist can select improved uncanny dodge as a ninja master trick.
